title: Slow English Podcast - My day! A2 Listening Practice🎧

header.titleZh: 慢速英語播客 - 我的一天！ A2聽力練習🎧
header.titleEn: Slow English Podcast - My day! A2 Listening Practice🎧

sentences.en: Welcome back to my Slow English podcast.
sentences.tc: 歡迎回到我的慢速英語播客。

sentences.en: Today I want to talk about my day so far because my day isn't over yet. It's just beginning.
sentences.tc: 今天我想談談到目前為止我的一天，因為我的一天還沒結束。這才剛開始。

sentences.en: Today I woke up at 5 a.m.
sentences.tc: 今天我早上 5 點起床。

sentences.en: In the morning. It was brutal. Finding the motivation to wake up at 5 a.m. can be very difficult.
sentences.tc: 在早晨。這很殘酷。找到凌晨 5 點起床的動力可能非常困難。

sentences.en: I always feel inspired to wake up, go for a run, and take a swim at the beach. Because the beach at 5 a.m. is so so peaceful. It's super relaxing.
sentences.tc: 我總是受到啟發，想要起床、去跑步、去海灘游泳。因為凌晨5點的海灘是如此的寧靜。真是超放鬆。

sentences.en: For me it's the best way to start my day. Plus, the beach is completely empty at 5 or 6 a.m. So,.
sentences.tc: 對我來說，這是開始新的一天的最佳方式。另外，海灘在凌晨 5 點或 6 點就完全空了。所以，。

sentences.en: I get to enjoy the beach all by myself. I ran to the beach. I swam for a little bit.
sentences.tc: 我可以獨自享受海灘。我跑到海灘。我遊了一會兒泳。

sentences.en: Then I sat in the sand and I took a moment to breathe and meditate for a little bit. I stretched for a little bit.
sentences.tc: 然後我坐在沙子上，花了一點時間呼吸和冥想。我稍微伸了個懶腰。

sentences.en: Then I was ready to walk back home.
sentences.tc: 然後我就準備步行回家。

sentences.en: Then I was ready to walk back to the room that I'm staying in. This room was only 5,000 Mexican pesos, so very cheap. And I have an amazing view.
sentences.tc: 然後我準備走回我住的房間。這個房間才5000墨西哥比索，非常便宜。我有一個令人驚嘆的景色。

sentences.en: My favorite places in the world. It really does have a special place in my heart.
sentences.tc: 世界上我最喜歡的地方。它確實在我心中佔有特殊的位置。

sentences.en: I got back home and I was starving. So hungry. My belly hurt and achd. So,.
sentences.tc: 我回到家，肚子餓了。太餓了。我的肚子又痛又痛。所以，。

sentences.en: I went to the kitchen to make myself a smoothie with spinach, pineapple, and water. A nice green juice to start my day. Now I'm recording for my YouTube channel.
sentences.tc: 我到廚房為自己做了一杯菠菜、鳳梨和水的冰沙。一杯美味的綠色果汁開始我的一天。現在我正在為我的 YouTube 頻道錄音。

sentences.en: Before going to meet my boyfriend at his work.
sentences.tc: 在去工作地點見我男友之前。

sentences.en: He is working at a hotel at the moment. So, I'll take a green juice, maybe some lunch and go see him for a little bit.
sentences.tc: 他現在在一家酒店工作。所以，我會喝杯綠汁，也許吃點午餐，然後去看他一會兒。

sentences.en: Then I'll work on my computer. I'll finish checking some emails.
sentences.tc: 然後我會在我的電腦上工作。我會檢查完一些電子郵件。

sentences.en: Then I plan to go to the beach again. I really like eating dinner at home or in a kitchen.
sentences.tc: 然後我打算再去一次海灘。我真的很喜歡在家裡或廚房吃晚餐。

sentences.en: I really love having homecooked meals. that are prepared at home. And here.
sentences.tc: 我真的很喜歡吃家常飯菜。那些在家準備的。還有這裡。

sentences.en: I have a kitchen. So, I always prefer to make something here rather than going out to eat at a restaurant. Don't get me wrong,.
sentences.tc: 我有一個廚房。所以，我總是更喜歡在這裡做點什麼，而不是去餐廳吃飯。別誤會我的意思，。

sentences.en: I love eating out.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡出去吃飯。

sentences.en: I love sitting down, ordering a meal, asking for recommendations. or suggestions. Trying new dishes and tipping the waiters or waitresses for their hard work, talking and chatting with friends.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡坐下來點餐，尋求建議。或建議。嘗試新菜餚，給辛勤工作的服務員小費，與朋友聊天。

sentences.en: I love cooking and eating at home with a movie on my computer even more. That's why I prefer eating at home.
sentences.tc: 我比較喜歡在家煮飯和吃飯，同時在電腦上看電影。這就是為什麼我更喜歡在家吃飯。

sentences.en: After swimming at the beach, I'll probably start cooking something for dinner. I'm thinking pasta, but I'm also craving hamburgers.
sentences.tc: 在海灘游泳後，我可能會開始做飯。我想吃義大利麵，但我也想吃漢堡。

sentences.en: I also think ceviche sounds really good. Ceviche is a dish in Mexico with so many vegetables and fish. It's so yummy. And usually.
sentences.tc: 我也覺得酸橘汁醃魚聽起來很不錯。酸橘汁醃魚是墨西哥的一道菜，裡面有很多蔬菜和魚。真是太好吃了。通常情況下。
